div.span: Who uses Pitcrew and which outside systems it talks to. Pitcrew keeps CI runners for Gitea and Forgejo going on a build machine; the network is used only to reach the server, to fetch runner releases and, when the user opts in, Pitcrew updates.

[Person]
Registers runners, watches the dashboard and tray, drains a runner for maintenance, approves updates.

div.i: [Software system: Tauri app + background service + Rust core]

div.div:
Keeps the runners running: starts them, restarts one that crashed or stalled (with back-off and crash-loop protection), updates them between jobs with roll-back, cleans their disk and shows it all in a dashboard and a tray icon.
Runs on Windows and macOS; Linux (systemd) is in progress. The service keeps supervising when the window is closed or the app crashes.

div.div:
Gitea / Forgejo server
[External system]
Runners register with it and poll it for jobs; the app reads job outcomes with a read-only token.

div.div:
Runner release hosts
[dl.gitea.com · gitea.com releases]
Latest runner version, binaries and SHA-256 checksums; two hosts must agree.
